rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis lists the same DFT-based conditions (temperature range, supercell size, functionals, pressure) as the target, but these are contradicted by the described intervention (classical MD on nanoparticles), so the conditions do not match the actual study regime.

rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts the same outcome as the target (80% savings, <0.5 meV/atom agreement, 48–57 K shift), but this prediction is not logically connected to the described intervention and is essentially copied from the target.
